get_legislation.description: Get a piece of legislation's details: its title and long title, citation, when it was made or enacted and comes into force, where it applies, whether its text is kept up to date and how many known changes are still to be made to it, with its table of contents. No API key required.

parameters.description: Which Act or instrument: its title, its citation (2018 c. 12, S.I. 2019/419), its reference from another step (ukpga/2018/12) or a link copied from legislation.gov.uk. A title matching several pieces of legislation stops the step and names them.
parameters.name: legislation

parameters.description: Its sections and schedules (an instrument's regulations or articles count as sections), every entry including parts and each schedule paragraph, or none.
parameters.name: contents

options.label: Everything, with parts and schedule paragraphs

body_paragraphs.description: How many numbered provisions its main body has.

category.description: 'primary' for an Act or Measure, 'secondary' for an instrument made under one.

citation.description: How it is cited, e.g. '2018 c. 12'.

coming_into_force.description: The days an instrument says it comes into force. Empty for an Act, whose sections are brought into force one by one.

contents.description: Its table of contents, in order.

items.description: One entry in the table of contents.

kind.description: What it is: section, regulation, article, rule, schedule, paragraph, part, chapter or heading.

provision.description: Where it is in the legislation, e.g. 'section/1' or 'schedule/2'. 'Get legislation text' takes it.

status.description: 'repealed' when it has been, otherwise empty.

within.description: The parts and headings it sits in, e.g. 'Part 2 General processing > Chapter 1 Scope and definitions'.

contents_count.description: How many rows the table of contents has.

date.description: The day it was enacted (an Act) or made (an instrument), YYYY-MM-DD.

extent.description: Where it applies, as the site abbreviates it, e.g. 'E+W+S+N.I.'.

is_revised.description: True when legislation.gov.uk keeps the text up to date with later amendments. False when it holds the text only as first made, as for most instruments.

last_modified.description: When legislation.gov.uk last changed it, YYYY-MM-DD.

long_title.description: What it is for, in its own words (its long title).

notes_url.description: Its explanatory notes or memorandum on legislation.gov.uk, when it has them.

outstanding_changes.description: How many changes by later legislation are known but not yet applied to the text. 'List changes to legislation' lists them.

pdf_url.description: A PDF of it as first printed, when there is one.

provisions_count.description: How many provisions it has: sections, paragraphs of schedules and so on.

reference.description: The legislation's reference on legislation.gov.uk: its type, year and number, e.g. 'ukpga/2018/12'. Every other action takes it.

schedule_paragraphs.description: How many paragraphs its schedules have.

type_name.description: Its type in words, e.g. 'UK Public General Act'.

version_date.description: For revised text, the day this version of it is in effect from, YYYY-MM-DD.

year.description: The year it was made or passed.

get_legislation_text.description: Get the words of one provision (a section, regulation, article or schedule) or of a whole piece of legislation, as numbered plain text with its amendment and commencement notes: the latest version, as first made, or as it stood on a date. Ready to summarise or send on. No API key required.

annotations.label: F1

mock_response.heading: Overview
mock_response.text:
1 [I1] Overview
(1) This Act makes provision about the processing of personal data.
(2) Most processing of personal data is subject to the [F1]UK GDPR.
(3) Part 2 supplements the [F2]UK GDPR.

kind.description: What it records: Textual amendment, Commencement, Modification, Extent, Editorial note, Footnote and so on.

characters.description: How long the whole text is, before any cut.

citation.description: How the legislation is cited, e.g. '2018 c. 12'.

outstanding_changes.description: How many changes by later legislation are known but not yet applied to this text.

description: Search and read UK legislation from legislation.gov.uk, The National Archives' official home of every Act and statutory instrument of the UK, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Find legislation by title, text, type and year, read any section as plain text (latest, as first made or on a date), see the changes made to it and by it, list its explanatory notes and impact assessments, and start a workflow when new legislation is published. No account or API key required.
